items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWEE] His wife, but he had died of that.

ctx.x: Yeah, I'm just like my head. But that's the first thing he said, oh, Bob's over again. That was my mother's sister.
His wife, but he had died of that.

She died of grief. He went away, he was supposed to center, but he just traveled and never did center. And she died of grief. She died in 1950. I met him in the middle of the night. She was a pretty woman.
